inverse_direction_call.meaning: updatePriceFeeds is invoked with inverse-direction parameters (QUOTE, BASE) rather than (BASE, QUOTE)

adapter_chain_configured.meaning: CrossAdapter is configured with base=wstETH, cross=stETH, quote=USD, oracleBaseCross for wstETH/stETH and oracleCrossQuote for stETH/USD

update_reverted.meaning: the updatePriceFeeds call reverts because the total fee does not match what was sent

assumptions: The inverse-direction call is a conditional scenario; no concrete transaction or actor is asserted.
No authorization requirement on updatePriceFeeds is stated, so none is encoded.
The fee mismatch is treated as the reported revert cause for this impact.

unresolved.description: Report does not fully specify whether fee mismatch is the sole revert cause versus other oracle errors, so the revert observable is bound to the fee-mismatch revert only.

limitations: Formalizes only the inverse_update_reverts impact; stale-price and bad-rate consequences are not covered by this plan.
The desired relation is expressed as absence of the reported revert under the inverse-direction scenario, not as a full oracle-routing correctness property.
